name: secureflow
description: Investigate authorized local Security Cases through SecureFlow without granting an agent final vulnerability authority.

interface.longDescription: SecureFlow connects Codex to authorized local Security Cases. Agents may validate structure, inspect evidence and stage recommendations, while final vulnerability decisions remain human-only.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this authorized Security Case and summarize the evidence.
Investigate this candidate and stage an abstention if evidence is insufficient.
Open Review Room for this local Security Case.
